tagline: Global asset management with active investment expertise
hero_kpi_rationale: Assets under management (AUM) are the primary revenue driver and a key indicator of T. Rowe Price's financial health, reflecting client confidence and the firm's ability to attract and retain global investments

kpis.name: Assets under management
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed by the company
kpis.description: Assets under management are a key indicator of the company's financial health
kpis.signal: Increase in assets under management due to market growth

kpis.name: Net cash flows
kpis.explanation: Net cash flows generated by investment activities
kpis.description: Net cash flows reflect the balance between client inflows and outflows, affecting the growth of assets under management
kpis.signal: Decline in net cash flows due to client outflows in growth strategies

kpis.name: Net market appreciation
kpis.explanation: Net gains on investments and distribution income
kpis.description: Net market appreciation and distribution income reflect the performance of managed portfolios and contribute to AUM growth
kpis.signal: Increase in net market appreciation due to equity and fixed income market growth

kpis.name: Assets under management in 2025
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed by the company in 2025
kpis.description: Assets under management are a key indicator of the company's financial health
kpis.signal: Increase in assets under management due to market growth

risks.title: Financial market fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in financial markets may lead to a decline in the value of assets under management, which would directly affect the company's fee revenues. (Item 1A, p. 54)

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the asset management industry is intense, with growing pressure toward passive products and fee compression, which could result in market share loss. (Item 1A, p. 54)

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Changes in regulations could have a negative impact on the company's operations and financial results. (Item 1A, p. 55)

risks.title: Dependence on management fees
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on asset management fees, which could lead to reduced revenues if fees decline or if AUM decreases. (Item 1A, p. 54)

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risk through its international operations and client portfolios denominated in foreign currencies. (Item 7A, p. 56)

risks.title: Loss of key personnel
risks.score_rationale: The loss of key investment managers and distribution professionals could negatively impact investment capabilities and the ability to attract clients. (Item 1A, p. 54)

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattacks that could affect its information systems, client data, and digital services. (Item 1A, p. 55)

ai_positioning.summary: T. Rowe Price notes that investors favored artificial intelligence-related businesses and high-growth companies in 2025, reflecting market trends that the firm addresses through its active investment strategies.
evidence: Market Trends section: 'investors favored artificial intelligence-related businesses and other high-growth companies'
